name: Alessandro Rossi
bio:
Alessandro's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering at the Politecnico di Milano, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he gained experience at a smaller Italian racing outfit, focusing on data analysis and simulation work. He quickly impressed with his ability to identify subtle performance gains and his meticulous approach to problem-solving.

Alessandro joined Tickford Racing seeking a greater challenge and the opportunity to work with a larger, more established team. He thrives on the pressure of race weekends and is known for his calm demeanor and clear communication under stress. Alessandro’s innovative mindset, combined with his deep understanding of vehicle dynamics, makes him a valuable asset in optimizing car setup and pushing the boundaries of performance. He is particularly skilled at identifying aerodynamic inefficiencies and proposing novel solutions.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: He has a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on using a specific brand of Italian coffee beans in the team's espresso machine.
